articles.summary: BT Group (LSE:BT.A) has just reported new figures for the first half of the year, including sales of £8,753 million, net income of £809 million, and a slightly larger interim dividend. Recent trading reflects that investors are rewarding BT Group for this mix of higher half year earnings and a slightly richer interim dividend, even as the delayed Starlink broadband launch adds a layer of perceived execution risk.
